v: kAyavyUha

kAye vAtAdInAM DAtUnAM saptAnAM tvagAdInAYca vyUho vyUhanam । kAyasTavAtAdonAM vinyAse “nABicakre kAyavyUhajYAnam” pAta॰ sU॰ “nABicakre saMyamaM kftvA kAyavyUhaM vijAnIyAt । vAtapittaSlezmARastrayo dozAH sapta santi DAtavaH--tvaglohitamAMsasnAyvasTimajjASukrARi pUrvvaM pUrvvamezAM bAhyamityevaMvinyAsajYAnam” BA॰ । 6 ta॰ । yogiBiH karmaBogArTaM kalpite 2 kAyasamudAye ca yaTA ca BogArTaM kAyavyUharacanA taTA cintAmaRO muktivAwe uktaM yaTA “yattu mA'Buktamiti smftiviroDena kzIyantEtyAdiSruteranyaTArTavarRanaM, tannasmfteH pratyakzavedabADitatvena tadvirudDArTa kavedAnanumApakatvAt । vAmadevasOBaripraBftInAM kAyavyUhaSravaRAttattvajYAnena kAyavyUhamutpAdya BogadvArA karmakzaya iti cenna tapaHpraBAvAdeva tattvajYAnAnutpAde vA kAyavyUhasamBavAt । BogajananArTaYca karmaBiravaSyaM tattatkAyanizpAdanamiti na tatra tattvajYAnopayogaH । yOgapadyaYca kAyAnAM tajjanakaDarmasvaBAvAt tapaHpramAvAd vA” । ekasyEva jOvasya cittAntarARikAyendriyARi ca nirmmAya tattatkarmmaBogArTaracitakAyavyUhena yoga ityetat SA॰ BA॰ samarTitaM yaTA । “saNkalpAdeva tu tacCruteH” SA॰ sU॰ । “hArdavidyAyAM SrUyate--“sa yadi pitflokakAmoBavati saNkalpAdevAsya pitaraH samuttizWantItyAdi” । tatra saMSayaH--kiM saNkalpa eva kevalaH pitrAdisamutTAnahetuH uta nimittAntarasahitaH? iti । tatra satyapi saNkalpAdeveti SravaRe lokavannimittAntarApekzA yuktA yaTA loke'smadAdInAM saNkalpAd gatyAdiByaSca hetuByaH pitrAdisampattirBavatyevaM muktasyApi syAt evaM dfzwaviparItaM na kalpitaM Bavizyati । saNkalpAdeveti tu rAjYEva saNkalpitArTasidDikarIM sADanAntarasAmagrIM sulaBAmapekzyocyate । na ca saNkalpamAtrasamutTAnAH pitrAdayomanoraTavijfmBitavaccaYcalatvAt puzkalaM BogaM samarpayituM paryyApnuyurityevaM prApte brUmaH--saNkalpA deva tu kevalAt pitrAdisamutTAnamiti । kutaH? tacCruteH “saNkalpAdevAsya pitaraH samuttizWantItyAdikA” hi Sruti rnimittAntarApekzAyAM pIdDyeta । nimittAntaramapi yadi saNkalpAnuviDAyyeva syAdBavatu na tu prayatnAntarasampAdyaM nimittAntaramizyate prAk tatsampatterbanDyasaNkalpatvaprasaNgAt । na ca Srutigamye'rTe lokavaditi sAmAnyato dfzwaM kramate । saNkalpabalAdeva cEzAM yAvatprayojanaM sTEryyopapattiH, prAkftasaNkalpavilakzaRatvAnmuktasaNkalpasya” BA॰ । “ataeva cAnanyADipatiH” sU॰ “ataeva cAbanDyasaNkalpatvAda nanyADipatirvidvAn Bavati nAsyAnyo'DipatirBavatItyaTaH । na hi prAkfto'pi saNkalpayannanyasvAmikatvamAtmanaH satyAM gatO saNkalpayati । SrutiScEtaddarSayati “aTa ya ihAtmAna manuvidya pravrajantyetAMSca satyAn kAmAn tezAM sarvezu lokeza kAmacAroBavatIti” BA॰ । “aBAvaM vAdarirAha hyevas” sU॰ “saNkalpAdevAsya pitaraH samuttizWanti” ityataH SrutermanastAvatsaNkalpasADanaM sidDaM SarIrendriyARi punaH prAptOSvaryyasya viduzaH santi na santIti samIkzyate tatra vAdaristAvadAcAryyaH SarIrasyendriyARAYcABAvaM mahIyamAnasya viduzo manyate । kasmAt? evaM hyAhAmnAyaH “manasEtAnkAmAn paSyan ramate yatra te brahmalokaH” iti । yadi manasA SarIrendriyESca viharet manaseti viSezaRaM na syAt । tasmAdaBAvaH SarIrendriyARAM mokze” BA॰ “BAvaM jEminirvikalpAmananAt” sU॰ “jEminirAcAryyomanovacCarIrasyApi sendriyasya BAvaM muktaM prati manyate, yataH “sa ekaDABavati triDA Bavati” ityAdinA'nekaDABAvakalpamAmananti nahyanekaviDatA vinA SarIraBedenAYjasI syAt । yadyapi nirguRAyAM BUmavidyAyAmayamanekaDABAve vikalpaH paWyate, taTApi vidyamAnamevedaM saguRAvasTAyAmESvaryaM BUmavidyAstutatye saNkIrtyata ityataH saguRavidyAPalaBAvenopatizWata ityucyate” BA॰ “dvAdaSAhabaduBayaviDaM vAdarAyaRo'taH” sU॰ “vAdarAyaRaH punarAcAryyo'taevoBayaliNgaSrutidarSanAduBayaviDatvaM sADu manyate, yadA saSarIratAM saNkalpayati tadA saSarIro Bavati, yadA tvaSarIratAM tadA aSarIra iti satyasaNkalpatvAt saNkalpavEcitryAcca, dvAdaSAhavat--yaTA dvAdaSAhaH satramahrInaSca Bavati uBayaliNgaSrutidarSanAt evamidamapIti” BA॰ “tadaBAve sanDyavadupapadyate” sU॰ “yadA tu sendriyamya SarIrasyABAvastadA yaTA sanDye sTAne SarIrendriyavizayezvavidyamAnezvapyapalabDimAtrAeva pitrAdikAmABavantyevaM mokze'pi syuH evaM tadupapadyate” BA॰ “BAve jAgradvat” sU॰ “BAve punastanoryaTA jAgarite vidyamAnAeva pitrAdikAmAsavantyevaM muktasyApyupapadyante” BA॰ “pradIpavadAveSastaTAhi darSayati” sU॰ “BAvE jEminirvikalpAmananAdityatra saSarIratvaM muktasyoktaM tatra triDA BAvAdizvanekaSarIrasarge kiM nirAtmakAni SarIrARi dAruyantravat sfjyante? kiM vA sAtmakAni? asmadAdiSarIravaditi Bavati vIkzA । tatrAtmamanasorBedAnupapatterekena SarIreRa yogAditarARi nirAtmakAnItyevaM prApte pratipadyate pradIpavadAveSa iti । yaTA pradIpaeko'nekapradIpaBAvamApadyate vikAraSaktiyogAt, evameko'pi san vidvAnESvaryyayogAdanekaBAvamApadya sarvvARi SarIrARyAviSati । kutaH! taTAhi darSayati SAstramekasyAnekaBAvam “sa ekaDA Bavati triDA Bavati paYcaDA saptaDetyAdi” । nEtaddAruyantropamAByupagame'vakalpate nApi jIvAntarAveSe । na ca nirAtmakAnAM SarorARAM pravfttiH samBavati । yattvAtmamanasorBedAnupapatteranekaSarIrayogAsamBava iti nEza dozaH ekamano'nuvfttIni samanaskAnyevAparARi SarIrARi satyasaNkalpatvAt srakzyati । sfzwezu ca tezUpADiBedAdAtmano'pi BedenADizWAtftvaM yAkzyate । ezEva ca yogaSAstrezu yoginAmanekaSarIrayogaprakiyA” BA॰ । yaTA ca paraSarore cittasyAveSastaTA pAta॰ sU॰ BAzyayoH darSitaM yaTA “banDakAraRaSETilyAt pracArasaMvedanAcca cittasya paraSarIrAveSaH” pAta॰ sU॰ “lolIBUtasya manaso'pratizWasya SarIre karmASayavaSAdbanDaH pratizWetyarTaH tasya karmaRobanDakAraRasya SETilyaM samADibalAdBavati pracArasaMvedanaYca cittasya samADijameva, karmabanDakzayAt svacittasya pracArasaMvedanAcca yAgI cittaM svaSarIrAnnizkfzya SarIrAntarezu niHkzipati niHkziptaM cittaYcendriyARyanupatanti yaTA maDukararAjAnaM makzikA utpatantamanutpatanti, niviSamAnamanuniviSante taTendriyARi paraSarIrAveSe cittamanuviDIyanta” iti vyAsaBA॰ ।

pu॰ BAratokte dasyupraBuBede tadutpattikaTAdi BA॰ SA॰ 135 a॰ yaTA । “nizAdyAM kzatriyAjjAtaH kzatraDarmAnupAlakaH । kAyavyo nAma nEzAdirdasyutvAt sidDimAptavAn । araRye sAyaM pUrvvAhRe mfgayUTaprakIpitA । viDijYo mfgajAtInAM nEzAdAnAYca kovidaH । sarvvakAlapradeSajYaH pAriyAtracaraH sadA । DarBajYaH sarvvaBUtAnAmamoGezurdfQAyuDaH । apyanekaSatA senA eka eva jigAya saH । sa vfdDAvanDabaDirO mahAraRye'ByapUjayat । maDumAMsErmUlaPalErannEruccAvacErapi । satkftya BojayAmAsa mAnyAn paricacAra ca । AraRyakAn pravrajitAn brAhmaRAn paripUjayan । api teByo mfgAn hatvA ninAya satataM vane । ye'smAnna pratigfhRanti dasyuto janaSaNkayA । tezAmAsajya gehezu kalya eva sa gacCati । bahUni ca sahasrARi grAmaRItve'Bivavrire । nirmaryyAdAni dasyUnAM niranukroSavarttinAm । dasyavaH UcuH । muhUrttadeSakAlajYaH prAjYaH SUro dfQavrataH । grAmaRIrBava no muKyaH sarvezAmeva saNgataH । yaTA yaTA vakzyasi naH karizyAmastaTA taTA । pAlayAsmAn yaTAnyAyaM yaTA mAtA yaTA pitA । kAyavya uvAca । sA baDAstvaM striyaM BIruM mA SiSuM mA tapasvinam । nAyuDyamAno hantavyo na ca grAhyA balAt striyaH । sarvvaTA strI na hantavyA sarvvasattvezu kenacit । nityantu brAhmaRe svasti yodDavyYja tadarTataH । satyaYca nABihantavyaM sArabiGnaYca mA kfTAH । pUjyate yatra devASca pitaro'tiTayastaTA । sarvvaBUtezvapi ca vE brAhmaRo mokzamarhati । kAryyA copacitistezAM sarvvasvenApi yA Bavet । yasya hyete sampraruzwA mantrayanti parABavam । na tasya trizu lokezu trAtA Bavati kaScana । yo brAhmaRAn parivadedvinASaYcApi rocayet । sUryyodaya iva DvAnte DruvaM tasya parABavaH । ihEva PalamAsInaH pratya kANkzeta sarvaSaH । ye ye no na pradAsyanti tAMstAMstenABiyAsyati । SizWyarTaM vihito daRqo na vfdDyarTaM viniScayaH । ye ca SizwAn pravADante daRqastezAM baDaH smftaH । ye ca rAzwrAparoDena vfdDiM kurvanti kecana । tadEva te'numIyante kuRape kramayo yaTA । ye punardDarmmaSAstreRa vartteranniha dasyavaH । api te dasyavo BUtvA kzipra sidDimavApnuyuH” ।
